Medium close-up at eye level on a 35mm lens, composed in 16:9. Scarlett (Image 1) VEGA stands beside the black stone sink, one hand reaching into an open coral carton on the vanity, fingers just about to grasp the lipstick, while the other hand rests near the counter for balance. Her attention is fixed on the carton, ignoring the phone buzzing beside a cup of cold coffee in the foreground. Compact modern downtown apartment bathroom, white tiled walls and mirror behind her. Hard morning sunlight cuts diagonally across the tiles and sink, creating crisp shadows and metallic highlights. Clean daylight photographic stock, tactile social-first beauty editorial, airy whites, muted neutrals, black contrast, vivid coral accent, subtle handheld energy.
